rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst, but it hedges between early-to-full blastulation and suggests image-based uncertainty despite the provided 3AA grade; some described details (e.g., possible two ICM clusters) are speculative.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian reserve, response to stimulation, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking strong morphology with age-related aneuploidy and BMI-related risk; only minor issue is slight overinterpretation of image morphology relative to the known lab grade.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice: recognition of Gardner grading limits, preference for single embryo transfer, luteal support, and selective discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include somewhat broad lifestyle/metabolic suggestions without clear indication.
Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, counseling, and future evaluation pathways; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
